## Walkthrough

This PR migrates the `kueue-populator` controller's Kubernetes events RBAC permissions from the core API group to the `events.k8s.io` API group. The change is applied consistently across the Kubebuilder source marker, generated ClusterRole policy, and Helm deployment template.

## Changes

**Events RBAC API Group Migration**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Events API group RBAC migration** <br> `cmd/experimental/kueue-populator/pkg/controller/controller.go`, `cmd/experimental/kueue-populator/config/rbac/role.yaml`, `cmd/experimental/kueue-populator/charts/kueue-populator/templates/manager.yaml`|Kubebuilder RBAC annotation is updated to grant `events.k8s.io` events `create` and `patch` permissions. The ClusterRole policy removes the core API group events rule and adds the `events.k8s.io` rule. The Helm template includes the `events.k8s.io` API group in ClusterRole rules.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#11955](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/11955): Both PRs update respective controller RBAC rules to grant `events` resource `create;patch` permissions under the `events.k8s.io` API group, migrating from core API group.
